These exact native Sonnet 18.53-Lite circuit-engine controls cover linear
project children. `native_child.s2p` is the constant 16.77 ohm two-pin child.
The three directories retain coarse/fine reactive children, original PRJ
parents, engine logs, metadata and complete-precision `response_nd.sid`.

The reactive parent requests 250, 300 and 350 MHz. The child declares either
200/400 MHz or a finer sweep; PRJ inheritance flags 0 and 1 both cause native
continuous evaluation at the parent frequencies. Complete SID matrices
agree with independent RLC MNA within 4e-15. The retained decimal response
log also agrees within its text-quantization bounds, reported separately in
`frequency_comparison.toml`.

The production regression uses these controls to check bounded snapshot
traversal and parent-frequency evaluation. Its physical SMD loaded geometry
and current maps are independently compared with the IDEAL resistor adapter.
Native SMD SPROJ itself remains blocked by the Lite license; these controls
do not establish native SMD renderer or coupled pin-calibration equivalence.

`sha256.json` identifies every retained evidence file by its exact bytes.
